title: Gatchalian notes 'unusual trend' in Sara Duterte's financial trail

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian on Tuesday observed an “unusual trend” in the financial transactions reported by Vice President Sara Duterte based on Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC) records. “From 2009 to 2013, ang transactions reported by VP Sara, for that time frame alone, it’s about P2.7 billion,” Gatchalian pointed out while questioning prosecution witness, AMLC Secretariat Executive Director Atty. Ronel Buenaventura. “It appears that transaction alone accounts for almost 70% to 80% of the total P3.3 billion in transactions,” he added.
